resources.string: Per message including attachments. Larger messages are downloaded partially and completed on Wi-Fi.
Per message including attachments. Also used to complete partially downloaded messages of the sync period.
Settings for the imported accounts. The values from the PC often do not suit the phone (e.g. only 25 messages, no notifications). Everything can be changed later in the account settings.
Only after the password is entered (account settings, incoming server). Then start it under "Fetching mail".
The setting from the PC does not count here: without it Android shows no notification.
Keeps a connection to the server open. Android requires a permanent notification for it; you can hide it (long press, turn off this kind of notification).
Otherwise Android stops NovaBird in the background after a while, and new messages only arrive when you open the app. Some makers (e.g. OPPO, Xiaomi) have an extra setting under App info, Battery.

Loads all messages of this account in one go, with the period and number of messages from the account settings. Only on Wi-Fi. "All folders" also switches synchronization on for every folder except trash and spam.
Runs with a notification, also with the screen off. If Wi-Fi goes away, it continues later on its own. Android allows this for about 6 hours a day; if it is not done by then, just start it again.
Done: all folders are loaded. Large messages are completed on Wi-Fi in the background.
Loading stopped with an error. Please try again.
The account has no password yet (e.g. after an import). Enter it in the account settings under the incoming server, then start again.
No folders to load: the server could not be reached or no folder is synchronized.
